supplemental_results.question: Inquiry 30
supplemental_results.retained_statement: Classify fixed programs for width-uniform tuple gaps or polynomial-depth approximate k-wise independence.
proved_restricted_statements: For N=2^w, <ROTR1, x->ROTR1(x)+1 mod N>=S_N for every w>=1. Both specified kernels act irreducibly on every ordered-distinct k-tuple space, 1<=k<=N; the pair chains are aperiodic and have uniform stationary law.
For the base program only, worst-case pair t_mix(1/4)>=(sqrt(2*pi)/8+o(1))*2^w*sqrt(w). This also lower-bounds all ordered-distinct k-tuple mixing times for k>=2.
For the base program only, the additive reversibilization has gap at most [((N-w-1)/(N(N-1)))/(w/4-w(w-1)/(2(N-1))-w^2/(N^2(N-1)^2))]=(4+o(1))/(w2^w).
supplemental_results.changed_assumptions: The first claim covers both supplied kernels; the mixing and Poincare claims restrict to R;+{0,1}. The Poincare claim explicitly uses additive reversibilization, not the nonreversible eigenvalue-modulus statistic.
supplemental_results.remaining: Exact asymptotics of either nonreversible eigenvalue-modulus gap; polynomial-depth possibility for the extra-MSB-XOR program; general program classification.
